rules.rule: The page (web/) is type-checked like the server, with svelte-check
rules.why: npm run check only covered src/; 13 errors had piled up in the page, some hiding real mistakes

rules.rule: Nullable state is typed with the generic: $state<T | null>(null)
rules.why: let x: T | null = $state(null) makes TypeScript narrow x to never, so every use of it goes unchecked

rules.rule: web/ and src/ never import each other; shapes they share go in web/src/lib/types.ts
rules.why: the page is bundled for the browser and the server runs on node: code crossing over breaks one of them

rules.rule: The GTK desktop window builds with every change to it
rules.why: it is Rust beside a TypeScript project: nothing else would notice it broke

rules.rule: No setTimeout or requestAnimationFrame to fix an ordering problem in a component: find what it waits for
rules.why: timers patch over a missing dependency, then get copied as the pattern; they also make the page janky

rules.rule: What cockpit keeps for a project stays in its .cockpit/ or in cockpit's own state folder, never in the project's setup
rules.why: cockpit is used on work projects whose structure isn't ours to change
